title: Ana akis performansi
purpose: Performance constraints embedded in home.dashboard. Skeleton shown on first load (AC-FR-E2-09-01). Critical cards (Bugun ozeti, Devam Et) loaded first via priority fetch (AC-FR-E2-09-02). Card-level retry on partial failures -- each section independent (AC-FR-E2-09-03). Performance NFR merged into home.dashboard ACs.

loading.description: Full-screen skeleton with shimmer. Critical card slots at top rendered first. Non-critical sections (recommendations, recent) deferred. PActivityIndicator at header. AC-FR-E2-09-01/02 satisfied.

ready.description: All sections loaded and interactive. Performance budget: <500ms to first interactive card. Telemetry event home_dashboard_viewed fires on ready.

empty.description: Dashboard empty but not errored: show onboarding prompts for each missing section.

error.description: Per-section error cards each with Tekrar Dene. Non-failing sections remain visible. Global retry only if >2 sections fail. AC-FR-E2-09-03 satisfied.

offline.description: Cached data served immediately (no loading state). OfflineBanner at top. Delta sync on reconnect.
